verifiedScope.dateDistinctions: Markers use original Italian standalone book-publication years, not composition, earlier periodical appearances, later omnibus editions or English translations. The Our Ancestors novellas appeared separately before their 1960 Italian omnibus and 1980 English collection. Invisible Cities and If on a winter’s night a traveler reached English in 1974 and 1981. Some Mr. Palomar pieces appeared in newspapers beginning in 1975; its marker uses the 1983 Italian book edition, while the English translation followed in 1985. Story collections, essays, editorial work and posthumous books such as Under the Jaguar Sun (1986) are excluded.
verifiedScope.influence: No claim of influence is inferred from chronological overlap.
